objects.description: During [C0027](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0027), [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) leveraged compromised credentials from victim users  to authenticate to Azure tenants.(Citation: Crowdstrike TELCO BPO Campaign December 2022)
